$comment: High and critical npm advisories that are knowingly accepted, checked by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
An entry is only legitimate when no forward fix exists: if npm offers a non-breaking upgrade, take the upgrade.
Every entry needs a reason that says why the advisory is not reachable in this product, and an expiry.
The gate fails once expires passes, once the advisory reaches a dependent outside dependents,
and once the advisory stops being reported at all -- so entries cannot quietly outlive their justification.

exceptions.reason: RSC-mode CSRF bypass. The UI mounts a plain BrowserRouter SPA in src/App.tsx with no RSC or framework mode, so the vulnerable request path is not built. No forward fix exists: the advisory covers 7.12.0-8.2.0 and npm's only offer is a downgrade to 7.11.0.
exceptions.review: Re-check whether react-router has shipped a fixed release above 8.2.0; take it if so.

exceptions.reason: Unbounded-expansion DoS, reached only through license-checker (brace-expansion -> minimatch -> glob -> read-package-json -> read-installed -> license-checker). license-checker is a devDependency that runs in CI against this repository's own dependency tree, so the input is not attacker-controlled and a crash fails the build rather than affecting a deployment. No forward fix exists: the advisory covers all of license-checker >=5.1.2 and npm's only offer is a downgrade to 5.1.1.
exceptions.review: Re-check for a license-checker release on a current glob, or replace the tool.
